mentions.name: NextPerf
mentions.description: This tool scans Next.js sites to identify what is slowing them down, highlighting issues such as slow LCP, heavy JavaScript, and third-party impact. It provides suggestions and prioritizes them, working best with Next.js apps.
mentions.problem: Performance issues when reviewing Next.js apps, with no clear way to see what is slow and what to fix first.
mentions.audience: Developers reviewing and optimizing Next.js apps.
mentions.source_excerpt: I ran into the same performance issues when reviewing Next.js apps, so I made a tool that scans Next.js sites and tells you what's slow. It's basically a performance tool that works best with Next.js apps, and highlights things like slow LCP, heavy JavaScript, and third-party impact and gives you suggestions and prioritizes them.
mentions.author: shandiz
